title: Genomic landscape of muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma in Uganda: A tumor-only whole-exome sequencing study.
snippet: Genomic data on muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma (MIUC) in African populations remain limited, constraining the interpretation of potentially clinically relevant alterations. title: The evolving immune ecosystem of TKI resistance in EGFR-mutant NSCLC: from treatment-induced remodeling to mechanism-guided therapy.
snippet: Tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) have transformed the treatment of EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), yet acquired resistance remains a major clinical limitation.
